description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log entries with priority, tag, message, and optional exception details, and appends them to the UI component.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log entries and appends them to the view, supporting chain chaining via the LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data with priority, tag, message, and throwable details, then appends it to the LogView UI. Also forwards the log to the next LogNode if configured.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
